questions: Did slalom and s-bend line_loss_events fall below 1.0 per run with the sensors at y 0.06 m?
At what step and on which bend does the first remaining loss occur, and what is max_error there?
Did steering_oscillation on the oval rise above the 0.27 seen at y 0.04 m? If so, is the forward offset causing overshoot?
Did oval progress hold near 0.5 as in iteration 2, or did it fall as it did with wheel_track 0.10 m?
Is the forward offset helping or hurting completion_time? Any run near 3 s?
feedback_request.requested_changes_if_any: If losses persist with oscillation at or below 0.3, report whether the remaining loss is on the tightest bend, which would point to the footprint or span. If oscillation exceeds 0.3, say whether the forward offset is causing overshoot so the next step can be sensor_size 0.016 m.

intent: Restore the iteration 2 baseline (10 cm span, 12 cm wheel_track, 12 mm footprints, 0.8 kg) and move the sensor row forward from y 0.04 m to y 0.06 m. This is a single-variable test of whether earlier sensing removes the persistent slalom and s-bend line loss at about 0.06 m. Expected result: slalom and s-bend line_loss_events below 1.0 per run, max_error below 0.06 m on the tight bends, and progress at or above the iteration 2 values.
learning: Iteration 3 showed that wheel_track 0.10 m reduced oval line losses to zero but cut oval progress from 0.51 to 0.14 and lowered the score from 124.6 to 62.6. Narrowing the track is therefore not a free gain. Progress and line-loss counts pull in different directions on the oval, so the next change should isolate sensing timing rather than drivetrain. The 10 cm span remains the best sensor span tested.
rationale: Iteration 3 (wheel_track 0.10 m) scored 62.6, below iteration 2's 124.6, so the narrower track is not an improvement. Oval progress fell from 0.51 to 0.14 and oval line losses went to 0, but the robot still ended off track. Oscillation dropped to about 0.07 on oval, so the robot is no longer wobbling, but it is not covering the course. S-bend progress fell from 0.27 to 0.19, and slalom stayed at 1.0 line loss per run with progress about 0.12. The best-scoring design so far is iteration 2: 10 cm span, 12 cm track, 12 mm footprints. I revert wheel_track to 0.12 m to recover that baseline. Slalom losses have persisted at about 1.0 per run through every span and track change (max_error about 0.061 to 0.064 m), which suggests the sensors see the tape too late on the slalom bends. The Integrator's feedback has not yet tested a forward shift, so I make that the single change from the best baseline: move all five sensors forward from y 0.04 m to y 0.06 m, within the allowed range. I expect slalom and s-bend line losses to fall below 1.0 per run and progress to rise from the iteration 2 values, because the robot reacts earlier. The risk is that the forward offset adds overshoot on the oval, where oscillation was already 0.27. If oscillation exceeds 0.3 again, the next lever is sensor_size 0.016 m.
